headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving gains for some firms while profit margins pressured others.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit for the majors to over 50% for Coforge, reflecting strong AI‑led demand. Profit growth was uneven; HCLTech and OFSS posted double‑digit profit rises, whereas Wipro saw a slight decline. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlook. Dividend payouts remained steady across most companies.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin dynamics
themes.detail: Operating margins varied widely, from OFSS’s 47.8% to Tech Mahindra’s 14.8%, showing divergent cost structures.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or raised interim dividends, signaling confidence in cash flow.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
AI revenue hit $219 m, profit jumped 21% YoY and margin stayed above 18%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 9.1% YoY while net profit fell 1.9% and headcount was cut.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance was trimmed to 1‑2%.
